Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run chase. Finn Allen and Devon Conway are the two openers for New Zealand. Mitchell Starc to start proceedings with the ball. Here we go...
... RUN CHASE ...

Right then, Australia are clearly ahead in this game with a competitive score to defend on a difficult pitch and with the bowling attack, they possess. They will be looking to come out and take early wickets to seal a comprehensive clean sweep in the series. New Zealand will have to bat much better than they have throughout this series if they are to complete an unlikely victory. They have Super League points to play for and have strengthened their batting going into the game. We hope for a fighting performance from them when we return for the run chase. Do join us shortly for the reply.

Steven Smith the centurion is up for a chat and he starts by saying it was pretty tough work at the start of the innings. Says they needed to take time as the opponents have a really good bowling attack and Trent Boult was swinging the ball in. Claims that it was a really good partnership with Marnus Labuschagne. Adds that he wasn't overthinking while batting and chose his moments to take on the bowlers as it was all about playing smart. Ends by saying they have a decent total on the board.

The Kiwi bowlers began with discipline and fire just the way they have done all through the series. Both Trent Boult and Tim Southee got a wicket each early on and pegged their opponents on the back foot straight away. They were unable to break down the stubborn partnership between Steven Smith and Marnus Labuschagne as the runs kept piling on. Lockie Ferguson broke the partnership but by then a platform had been set for the big hitters of Australia to launch into an attack. They did keep chipping away at the wickets and did not let their opponents run away with the game and will hope that their batting clicks this time around to take them home. Trent Boult was the pick of the bowlers taking 2 wickets for 25 runs in his full quota of 10 overs. They would have hoped to restrict Australia closer to the 230-run mark with the way they started.

Australia got off to a poor start with their makeshift opener Josh Inglis departing early and their out-of-form skipper Aaron Finch following suit. He left the ground to a standing ovation in appreciation for his long and successful ODI career. His wicket brought Steven Smith and Marnus Labuschagne to the wicket together and they began the rebuilding process. They found it difficult to score runs initially but they picked up the scoring rate as their innings progressed. They put on a 118-run partnership for the third wicket with Marnus Labuschagne being dismissed after a well-made half-century. Steven Smith was unstoppable though as he went on to score his 12th ODI century. He put on a 69-run partnership with Alex Carey to keep the scoreboard motoring along. Alex Carey and Cameron Green provided the finishing touches and pushed Australia close to the 270-run mark.

Quite a flourish from the hosts right at the end! Australia have clawed themselves to a comfortable position with 267 runs on the board. They will be really happy with this score on a difficult pitch and against an in-form bowling lineup. The bulk of the credit goes to Steven Smith who once again dragged Australia out of a pickle. New Zealand started well but once again faded as the game progressed and they will now have their task cut out if they are to seal a consolation win.
15 runs form the last over! This is full and on middle, Alex Carey drills it down to long on for a couple of runs. Australia finish on 267 for 5.
A low full toss again and on off, Cameron Green slaps it down to long off for a run.
SIX! Green sends this one into the stands. This is a slower one, pitched up and on leg, Cameron Green picks it up, waits for it and dispatches it over the deep sqaure leg fence for a maximum.
FOUR! This time Green does not miss out. This is another low full toss and on off, Cameron Green stays there and smashes it towards the deep mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
A slower ball, full and on off, Alex Carey goes down and scoops it towards short fine leg for a single.
A full toss and on leg, Cameron Green drives it down to long on for a run. Neesham gets lucky here as it was there to be put away.
A slower short ball, on middle, Cameron Green reads it this time and holds his pull shot to play it through square leg for a single. Boult finishes with 2 wickets for 25 runs in his 10 overs.
Goes fuller and on middle, Alex Carey drills it towards long on for a single.
Change of pace from Boult, on a length and outside off, Cameron Green guides it towards point for a run.
FOUR! Green looks in good touch here. Boult bowls this short of  length and on leg, Cameron Green uses his wrists to flick it away towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
WIDE! This is full but way outside off, Green leaves it. Wided.
A slower ball, on a length and outside off, Cameron Green looks to play the ramp shot but gets beaten due to the lack of pace.
Trent Boult goes full and into the pads, Alex Carey clips this to deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
SIX! Stand and deliver! This is on a hard length and on middle, sits up nicely for the batter, Cameron Green picks up the length early and heaves it over the deep square leg fence for a biggie.
Tim Southee goes full this time and outside the off pole, Cameron Green steps across the stumps and looks to paddle this fine. Misses and gets hits on the pad.
Serves this on a good length and outside off, Alex Carey taps this towards backward point and rushes across for another single.
Continues bowling on a good length and in line with the stumps, Cameron Green gets across the stumps and tucks this to deep square leg for a single.
This is on a good length and outside off stump as well, Alex Carey strokes this towards deep cover and takes a run.

FOUR! That is a really nice shot from Alex Carey. A bit of innovation gets him a boundary. Tim Southee bowls this full and outside off, Alex Carey plays a reverse hit past the short fine leg fielder for four runs,
Full and outside off, Cameron Green knocks it towards mid off.
Slower again, short and outside off, Alex Carey pulls it towards deep square leg for a run.
A slower one, on a length and on middle, Alex Carey lofts it wide of long off where the fielder runs to his left, dives in to save a couple of runs.

OUT! TAKEN! Trent Boult gets the big man, Glenn Maxwell! Another no show for the 'Big show'. Boults bowls this slower, full and on leg, Glenn Maxwell fails to pick it, but still goes for the big heave. However, he did not get under the ball and hits it flat and in the air towards deep square leg where Mitchell Santner takes a couple of steps forward and pouches it safely. Cameron Green walks out to bat now.
Commentary.Howout: c Mitchell Santner b Trent Boult

Commentary.Commentary: Full and on off, Glenn Maxwell drills it wide of long on for a couple of runs.
A slower one, short and on off, Alex Carey waits for it and slaps it down to long on for a run.
Short and outside off, Alex Carey punches it towards deep point for a single.
On a length and on leg, Alex Carey flicks it towards fine leg for a brace.

DROPPED! This is on a hard length and on middle, Glenn Maxwell tries to clear mid off, but cannot get the right timing and the ball goes in the air behind mid off. Kane Williamson there runs back, stretches his arms to catch it but he spills it as his shoulders hit the ground. A big oppurtunity goes begging. Two runs taken.
FOUR LEG BYES! Lockie Ferguson strays down the leg side and serves this full, Glenn Maxwell misses his flick, but the ball goes off his pads towards the fine leg fence for a boundary anyways.

Bowls this short and in line with the stumps, Glenn Maxwell makes room and swats this towards square leg. The throw comes in from the deep and hits the stumps and goes towards third man. They get an extra run.
Lockie Ferguson bowls this full and in line with the stumps, Alex Carey clips this to deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
SIX! BANG! Glenn Maxwell makings his intention clear. This is tossed up, full and on off, Glenn Maxwell goes down and slog-sweeps it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Floated, full and on middle, Alex Carey sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
A bit short and on middle, Alex Carey knocks it towards mid-wicket.
A single as this full ball is driven towards long on.
Tossed up, full and on off, Glenn Maxwell looks for the reverse sweep straight away, but gets it more from the bottom half as the ball goes through the keeper and towards third man. Two runs taken.
Glenn Maxwell comes out to the middle and the platform has been set for him to launch into an onslaught.

OUT! TIMBER! Steven Smith looks to take on Santner, but loses his wicket in the process. Santner flights this up, on middle, straightens after hitting the surface, Steven Smith skips down the track to loft it over extra cover, but misses it completely as the ball goes on to rattle the stumps. A great innings by Smith and he has put Australia in a strong position.
Slower delivery bowled full and in line with the stumps, Steven Smith clips this towards mid-wicket who dives to his left and parries the ball to long on for a single.
Back of a length this time and outside off. Steven Smith will feel like he missed out as he cuts this straight to the point fielder.
WIDE! Strays down leg side on a fuller length, Steven Smith misses his flick and this is called wide by the umpire.
FOUR! UP AND OVER! This is full and on middle and off, Steven Smith gets hi front leg out of the way and lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
Back of a length and on off, Alex Carey forces it towards mid off for a quick run.
Fuller and on off, Alex Carey moves across and scoops it towards fine leg for a brace.

HUNDRED FOR SMITH! This is his 12th ODI century and he absolutely loves batting on home soil. This is on a length and around leg, Steven Smith tucks it away through square leg for a single. The crowd roars and Smith celebrates the landmark by removing his helmet and acknowledging the crowd. This has been a great inning from him as he has dug Australia out of the mess they were in early on.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Steven Smith eases it towards long on for a single. He gets to 99 now.
Gives it some air this time, on off, turning in, Alex Carey punches it through mid-wicket for a single.
Shortish in length and on off, turning away, Steven Smith cuts it to deep point for a run. He moves on to 98.
Flatter and around middle, Steven Smith chips it over the bowler and towards wide long off for a brace.
Shorter again and outside off, Steven Smith cuts it but striaght to point.
Short and outside off, Steven Smith slaps it back to Santner who fields well.
Fuller one and on middle, Steven Smith drives it down to long on for a run.
FOUR! Nice shot! Ferguson lands this short and on leg, Steven Smith gets into positon quickly and hooks it wide of the fine leg fielder for a boundary. He moves into the 90s.
Ferguson comes around the wicket and serves this full, on middle, Alex Carey drills it down to long on for a run.
This is on a hard length and around off, Steven Smith guides it past the diving point fielder for a single.
Full and on middle, angling in, Steven Smith drives it straight to mid off.
A slower length ball, on middle, Steven Smith only manages to push it back to the bowler.
Tim Southee bowls a slower delivery full and outside the off pole, Steven Smith uses his wrists and clips the ball into the mid-wicket region for a single and keeps strike.
Strays onto the pads from over the wicket to the right-hander. Serves this on a fuller length and Steven Smith clips this towards deep backward square leg for a brace.
This is on a good length and outside the off stump, Alex Carey looks to swing across the line but gets an inside edge down to fine leg for a single.
This is angling into the pads on a fuller length, Alex Carey misses his flick and gets a hit in the pads.
Goes 'round the wicket to the left-hander and serves this full and outside off. Alex Carey gets across and blocks this towards mid-wicket.
Tim Southee begins with a short delivery outside off, Steven Smith cuts this to the right of point who dives and restricts them to a single.
Powerplay 3! Now, fives fielders are allowed outside the circle till the last over. Tim Southee (7-1-29-1) is back on.
Continues bowling on a good length and outside the off pole, Alex Carey taps this towards the point fielder.
This is on a good length but wide outside off, Steven Smith slaps this to deep backwards point and takes a single.
Back of a length and outside off, Steven Smith punches off his back foot but cannot beat covers.
Lockie Ferguson full and angles this into the pads, Steven Smith clips this well but a dive at mid-wicket saves a certain boundary.
This is on a good length and outside off at 145 clicks. Steven Smith mistimes his shot back towards the bowler.
Lockie Ferguson serves this back of a length and outside off, Steven Smith guides this to deep backward point for a couple of runs.
This is fired in from shorter length into the pads, Alex Carey misses his flick and gets hit on the pads.
Bowls this a fraction short and just outside off, Alex Carey blocks this back towards the bowler.
This is full and pitching on leg, Alex Carey sweeps this straight to short fine leg.
Mitchell Santner strays onto the pads on a fuller length, Alex Carey sweeps this towards fine leg for a couple of runs.
Bowls a loopy full toss outside off, Steven Smith hits this in the air towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Steven Smith is on the offensive now! Mitchell Santner floats this one full and outside off, Steven Smith shimmies down the wicket and hits an inside-out shot towards deep cover for four runs.
FOUR! This has been caressed through the turf! James Neesham goes full and just outside off, Alex Carey punches this to the left of mid off and collects another lovely boundary.
Bowls this a touch fuller and angled into the stumps, Steven Smith clips this to the left of mid-wicket and takes a single.
This is on a good length and angled into the pads, Alex Carey clips this to deep backward square leg for a single.
Bowls this on a good length and just outside off, Steven Smith taps this towards the off side and scampers across for a single.
Free Hit has been wasted. James Neesham bowls a slower delivery short of length and outside off, Steven Smith swings but misses as he is beaten by the pace.

NO BALL AND SIX! Steven Smith is creating shots here! The talisman takes a ball from outside off on a shorter length and pulls it well over the deep square leg boundary for a biggie! To make matters worse, James Neesham has overstepped and now they have a Free Hit.
James Neesham bowls this on a good length and outside off, Alex Carey guides this to third man for a single.
James Neesham (6-0-35-0) comes back into the attack.

This is full once again and outside off, Steven Smith gets well across the stumps and goes to sweep this towards the leg side. Slips while playing the shot and gets the ball to deep backward square leg for a couple of runs.
WIDE! Straying down leg side on a fuller length. Alex Carey misses the sweep shot and the keeper does not collect. They take an extra run off the wide.
This is wide outside off on a fuller length, Steven Smith reaches for it and knocks it to deep cover-point for another run.
Floats this one full and outside off, Alex Carey sweeps this to deep backward square leg and takes just one.
This is a fraction short and spinning into the stumps, Steven Smith clips this towards long on and takes an easy single.
Fights this one full and outside off, Steven Smith shimmies down the wicket and blocks the ball towards cover.

Mitchell Santner bowls this quicker and gets the ball to turn into the pads, Alex Carey looks to work this leg side but misses. The ball hits the pads and rolls to short fine leg as the take a leg bye.
Mitchell Santner (6-0-23-0) replaces Trent Boult.
This is full as well and in line with the stumps, Alex Carey flicks this to deep mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! This has been exquisitely timed! Lockie Ferguson goes full this time and just outside off, Alex Carey punches this down the ground with a straight bat and finds the boundary at straightish long off. His first boundary and this should give him some confidence.
Going into the pads once more on a good length, Steven Smith rotates the strike as he takes a single to deep square leg.
In line with the leg stump on a good length, Alex Carey works this towards square leg for a run.
This is on a good length as well and outside off, Alex Carey taps this towards backward point.
Lockie Ferguson bowls this on a good length and angling into the pads, Steven Smith clips this to deep square leg for a single.
Fourth maiden for Trent Boult in this game! Bowls this slightly outside off on a good length. Alex Carey strokes this towards extra cover.
Make that five! Delivers this on a good length once again and outside off, Alex Carey taps this down into the pitch.
Trent Boult continues bowling on a good length and in line with the stumps, Alex Carey looks to flick this leg side but gets a leading edge towards cover. Four dot balls in a row.
This is on a good length and nipping back into the stumps, Alex Carey works this to the left of mid-wicket and looks for a single. Sent back by Steven Smith.
Goes slightly full and angles this into the pads, Alex Carey clips this towards mid-wicket.
Trent Boult bowls this on a good length and just outside off, Alex Carey taps this towards short cover.

Lockie Ferguson bowls this full and in line with the stumps, Alex Carey clips this towards mid-wicket. Misfield by Mitchell Santner allows a single and Alex Carey gets off the mark. End of a successful over by Lockie Ferguson.
Alex Carey comes out to the middle now.

OUT! CAUGHT! The 118-run partnership has finally been broken! Bowls a slower delivery at 126 clicks back of a length and outside off, Marnus Labuschagne looks to pull but gets a top edge towards mid on. Trent Boult runs in and takes a comfortable catch. New Zealand finally have a breakthrough and they will be hoping for a few more soon.
Commentary.Howout: c Trent Boult b Lockie Ferguson

Commentary.Commentary: On a good length and straying onto the pads, Steven Smith tucks this towards deep square leg for a single.
WIDE! Lockie Ferguson serves this one well outside the off stump on a fuller length. Steven Smith leaves this one alone and is called wide by the umpire.

FOUR! This has been timed wonderfully! Lockie Ferguson bowls this full and outside off, Steven Smith strokes this to the right of mid off. Kane Williamson dives and gets a hand to it but can not stop it from running away to the long off fence for four runs.
Goes slightly full and angles this in from outside off, Marnus Labuschagne clips this wide of long on and takes a single.
Lockie Ferguson begins with a good length delivery in line with the stumps, Marnus Labuschagne looks to flick this leg side but misses and gets hit high on the pads.

Drinks! Steven Smith and Marnus Labuschagne have added over 100 runs and both of them have gone past their half-centuries. They have build up the perfect platform to launch for Australia. New Zealand needs to break this partnership to comeback in this game. Also, Lockie Ferguson (5-0-23-0) comes back into the attack.
Goes full this time and serves this outside off, Steven Smith strokes this firmly to mid off. Five dot balls to end the over and just three runs from it.
Bangs this one short and past the leg stump, Steven Smith gets across the line and leaves it at the last moment. The umpire reckons this is not wide.
Goes for the yorker once again but this is outside the off stump. Steven Smith knocks this towards backward point.
Bowls a yorker and in line with the stumps, Steven Smith digs this out back towards the bowler.
This is short as well and outside off, Steven Smith forehands this towards mid-wicket.

Fifty for Marnus Labuschagne now! Trent Boult comes 'round the wicket and bowls this back of a length outside off, Marnus Labuschagne punches this through covers and takes three runs. He is matching Steven Smith with his stroke play.
Trent Boult (6-3-7-1) is back on.
A bit fuller and on middle, Steven Smith mistimes his drive towards mid on.
Short of a length and outside off, Steven Smith looks to cut it but gets a bottom edge onto the ground as the ball dies there.

FOUR! Easy pickings for Smith! Neesham is getting it all wrong here as he continues to bowl fuller, this one is on middle, Steven Smith plays another beaitful on drive and the ball races away to the long on fence.
On a length and around off, Steven Smith blocks it out.
Full again, on off, Marnus Labuschagne check drives it onto the ground, and the bounces takes it over the outstreched hand of Neesham. A single is taken.
Full and on middle, Marnus Labuschagne nicely flicks it away towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.

FOUR! Second boundary of the over! Tim Southee bowls this on a length and strays onto the pads, Steven Smith clips this towards deep backward square leg for a boundary. Brings up the 100-run partnership between these two and that will be 11 runs from the over.
Slower delivery bowled on a good length and outside off, Steven Smith looks to slash at this but is beaten as the ball goes through to the keeper.
Goes full this time outside off, Steven Smith blocks this towards cover.
This is on a good length and outside off, Steven Smith guides this towards short third man.

FOUR! Half-century for Steven Smith and the run-machine keeps rolling! Tim Southee bowls this on a good length and outside off, Steven Smith makes room and swats this over mid off. The ball runs away to the long off boundary for four runs. Steven Smith raises his bat and acknowledges the applause from the crowd.
Goes full once again and outside off, Steven Smith looks to work this off side but gets an inside edge towards deep square leg for a couple of well-taken runs.
WIDE! Starts the over with a loose delivery straying down leg on a fuller length. This has been called wide.
Neesham lands this short of a length, on the pads, Steven Smith flicks it through square leg for another run.
Touch fuller and on middle, Steven Smith blocks it out.
Shorter one and on middle, Marnus Labuschagne pulls it towards deep square leg for a run.
This is short of length and outside off, Steven Smith reaches out for it, but cannot find the gap as the fielder at cover-point gets a hand to it. They cross. Smith is not happy with himself.
FOUR! Nicely timed! This is pitched up, on middle, Steven Smith stays there and shows the full face of the bat to drives it towards the vacant long on fence for a boundary.
Neesham serves this full and outside off, Marnus Labuschagne drives it through covers for a single.
Fuller one and on off, Marnus Labuschagne drills it through covers for another run.
Back of a length and on middle, Steven Smith uses his feet and clips it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Strays on the pads this time on a good length, Marnus Labuschagne tucks this to fine leg for one.
Tim Southee bowls this on a good length and outside off, Steven Smith works this towards deep cover-point and takes a single.
Another full delivery, on middle, Marnus Labuschagne works it towards long on for a run.
Full and outside off, Marnus Labuschagne leans on and blocks it to the left of mid off.
Tim Southee (5-1-12-1) is back into the attack now as New Zealand are desperate for a breakthrough.
On a length and on off, Marnus Labuschagne blocks it towards point.

A slower one, pitched up, on off, Marnus Labuschagne digs it out, and the ball loops up towards point. The New Zealand are asking for the catch but the finger stays down. The umpire sends it upstairs to check, and the soft signal is Not Out. The replay clearly shows that it is a bump ball and the on field decision remains.
A bit fuller, on middle, Marnus Labuschagne knocks it to the leg side.
FOUR! Another boundary for Marnus Labuschagne! This is almost on a yorker length and outside off, Marnus Labuschagne squeezes it towards the vacant third man fence for four more runs.
On a length and on middle, Marnus Labuschagne tucks it towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Nice placement! This is pitched up and outside off, Marnus Labuschagne pierces the gap on the off side expertly as the ball runs away to the deep point fence for his first boundary.
Just wide! This is slower through the air, on middle, Steven Smith is through his drive a bit early, and the ball goes uppishly, but wide of Santner towards long off. A single taken.
A bit short and outside off, Marnus Labuschagne goes back and punches it towards deep point for a run.
Marnus Labuschagne skips down the track, makes this a full toss, but drives it straight to covers.
Tossed up, full and on off, Steven Smith knocks it towards point for a single.
Slightly shorter and on middle, Steven Smith goes on his back foot and pushes it to the right of the bowler where Santner fields it.
Floated, full and on off, Marnus Labuschagne eases it towards long off for a single.
Ferguson uses the width of the crease and serves a full delivery, angling into the stumps, Steven Smith covers his stumps and blocks it out. Only 3 runs from the over.
Full delivery again and outside off, Steven Smith stays in his crease and drives it straight to point.
Fullish one and on middle, Steven Smith tucks it with his back foot in the air towards mid-wicket.
Length again and outside off, Marnus Labuschagne waits for it, and plays it late towards third man for one.
Goes fuller and on off, Steven Smith drills it towards deep point for a run.
This is on a good length and around off, Marnus Labuschagne opens the face of his bat and guides it towards third man for a single.
Lockie Ferguson (3-0-12-0) has been brought back into the attack.
Persists with the outside off stump on a fuller length, Marnus Labuschagne keeps strike as he takes a single to long off.
Continues bowling full and outside the off pole, Steven Smith thumps this down to long off for another single.
Mitchell Santner flights this full and outside off, Steven Smith stays back in the crease and plays this late towards fine leg for a couple of runs.
This is full as well and in line with the stumps, Steven Smith shimmies down the wicket and blocks the ball back towards the bowler.
Floats this one full and outside off, Marnus Labuschagne slaps this hard towards long off for a single.
Mitchell Santner flights this full and angles this into the stumps, Marnus Labuschagne clips this towards mid-wicket.
This is full once again and outside off. Marnus Labuschagne flicks this to the left od mid-wicket once again but the fielder gets across and restricts them to a single this time.
Goes full this time and just outside off, Marnus Labuschagne uses his wrists and clips the ball to the left of mid-wicket into the gap. They take a couple of runs.
Bowls a full toss as he attempts a slower yorker and delivers this outside off, Steven Smith knocks this to deep cover and rotates the strike wth a single.
On a good length this time and outside the off pole, Steven Smith blocks this towards the cover fielder.
Bowls this back of a length and outside the off stump, Marnus Labuschagne taps this down towards short third man.
James Neesham bowls this on a good length and serves this outside off, Steven Smith taps this to the left of cover and takes a quick single.
Flights this one full and outside the off pole, Steven Smith strokes this to long off and takes a single to keep strike.
Goes outside off this time on a fuller length, Steven Smith blocks this to the left of the bowler.
Mitchell Santner straying in line as he goes on the pads once again on a shorter length. Marnus Labuschagne tucks this towards backward square leg and takes one.
Fires this one full and into the pads, Steven Smith clips this towards square leg and they take another run.
Slightly short and angling into the pads, Marnus Labuschagne clips this towards square leg and takes a single.
Mitchell Santner floats this one full and into the stumps, Steven Smith digs this out towards long on for a run.
Mitchell Santner (3-0-10-0) comes back into the attack.
Bowls this short and outside off, Steven Smith pulls this to deep square leg for a single to end the over. Just this one run from the over.
Make that five! On a good length once again and outside the off pole. Steven Smith looking solid in defense and he taps this towards cover.
Goes back to bowling on a good length and outside the off stump, Steven Smith dabs this towards the off side. Four dot balls on the trot.
Full once again and in line with the stumps, Steven Smith blocks this back towards the bowler.
This is a touch fuller and outside off, Steven Smith taps this towards the cover-point fielder.
James Neesham bowls this on a good length and outside the off stump. Cross seam delivery that wobbles after pitching and beats the outside edge of Steven Smith's bat as he looks to cut.
This is a touch fuller and outside off, Marnus Labuschagne knocks this straight at the cover fielder.
Continues bowling on a good length and on an outside off stump line, Steven Smith punches this down to long on for another run.
This is on a good length and angled into the off stump, Marnus Labuschagne clips this towards long on for one.

The wicket-keeper comes up to the stumps, Daryl Mitchell bowls this full and just outside off, Marnus Labuschagne hits this back towards the bowler who gets his hand to it and parries it towards mid off.
Bowls this on a good length and outside off, Steven Smith rocks back and punches this to the deep in the cover region and takes another run.
Daryl Mitchell serves a full delivery outside the off stump, Marnus Labuschagne strokes this towards deep cover for a single.
A dot to end the over! Neesham lands this on a length and on off, Steven Smith blocks it out.
Neesham continues bowling full, on off, Marnus Labuschagne moves across and works it past short mid-wicket for one more.
Another full delivery, on middle, Steven Smith tucks it through square leg for another run.
Fuller and on middle, Marnus Labuschagne flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
A yorker, on middle, Steven Smith squeezes it past mid-wicket for a run. The fielder from mid off covers his ground well to his right to stop the ball.
Full and on the pads, Marnus Labuschagne helps it through square leg for a single.
Decides to bowl full once again and angled into the stumps, Steven Smith blocks this back towards the bowler. Just three runs from Daryl Mitchell's first over.
Slightly wide outside off on a good length, Marnus Labuschagne guides this to deep cover-point and take a single.
Goes a touch fuller and outside the off stump, Marnus Labuschagne gets a confident stride forward and strokes this ball to mid off.
This is on a good length and on middle, Steven Smith gets across and flicks it towards fine leg for a run. Marnus Labuschagne wants the second but he is sent back.
Full again and on middle, Marnus Labuschagne works this towards long on for a single.
Fullish one, on off, shaping away, Marnus Labuschagne guides it towards point.

FOUR! Back-to-back for Smith! This is again pitched up, on off, Steven Smith leans on and drives it firmly through covers for another boundary, He did not try to hit it too hard and just stroked it away.
FOUR! This is classic Smith! Neeshem pitches this one up, on middle, Steven Smith stays there and drills it past the bowler for a beautiful boundary.
This is on good length and on middle, holds its line, Steven Smith gets squared but blocks it out well.
Short of a length and outside off, Steven Smith looks to cut it, but gets a bottom edge onto the ground as the ball goes past the stumps.
This is on a good length and around off, Steven Smith looks to drive it but gets an inside edge ont his pads, and the ball loops of off his forearm, but falls well short of the bowler.
Neesham starts with a good-length delivery, on middle, Steven Smith knocks it towards mid on.

DRINKS! Australia have lost their opening pair and have gotten off to a circumspect start. They have their top batters out in the middle though and will be hoping they can build on this partnership and take Australia to a competitive total. New Zealand will be thoroughly pleased with their performance and have got their opponents on the back foot. They will be looking to break this partnership and keep chipping away at the wickets. The game should get moving after the break.
A single to end the over as this full ball is driven towards long off.
Looped up, full and on off, Steven Smith knocks it towards covers.
Floated, full and on midde, Steven Smith tucks it towards square leg and sets off for the run, but Marnus Labuschagne sends him back and rightly so.

Oh..that was close! This is flatter and quciker, on middle and leg, skids through the surface, Steven Smith gets cramped on his back foot ,and misses as he looks to block it out. The ball hits his pads but it is going past the leg stump.
A bit short and on off, Marnus Labuschagne punches it through covers for a run.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Marnus Labuschagne goes down and drives it hard wide of deep square leg, where Boult runs to his left, puts in a dive to stop it. Two runs taken.
Back of a length and around off, Steven Smith bunts it towards point and denies for the single.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! This is just the second boundary of this innings. Ferguson bowls a half-volley, outside off, Steven Smith stays there and drives it through covers for four runs.
On a length and on off, Steven Smith leans on and blocks it towards covers.
Pulls his length back a bit and on off, Marnus Labuschagne look to block it out, but gets an outside egde past short third man for a single.
Full and on middle, Marnus Labuschagne nicely tucks it through mid-wicket for a brace.
This is almost on a yorker length at 148 kmph, around off, Marnus Labuschagne tries to dig it out but misses.
WIDE! Lockie Ferguson loses his line as he bangs this short ball way down the leg side. Wided.
Mitchell Santner bowls this slightly short and outside off, Marnus Labuschagne works this to deep point and takes a run to keep strike.
Tosses this one full and in line with the middle stump, Marnus Labuschagne dabs this back down the pitch.
Bowls this a fraction short and angles this into the batter at a quicker pace, Marnus Labuschagne rocks back and punches this towards cover.
This is full as well and just outside off, Marnus Labuschagne gets across the stumps and sweeps it wide of deep square leg for a brace.
Floats this one full and outside off, Steven Smith strokes this to long off and takes a run.
Mitchell Santner flights this full and in line with the stumps, Steven Smith blocks this to the right of the bowler.
Lockie Ferguson continues bowling full and outside the off pole, Marnus Labuschagne is hitting the ball well but can not find the gap past cover-point.
This is a touch fuller and outside off, Marnus Labuschagne times his shot well but finds the cover fielder.
Short once again and outside off, Marnus Labuschagne pulls this wide of deep mid-wicket and takes a couple of runs to add to his kitty.
Pulls his length back a fraction and serves this outside off, Marnus Labuschagne stands tall and blocks the ball to the off side.
Goes outside off this time on a good length, Marnus Labuschagne defends this towards covers.
Lockie Ferguson begins the over with a good-length delivery angling in from outside off, Marnus Labuschagne blocks this towards mid on.
Mitchell Santner fires this one full and into the stumps, Marnus Labuschagne taps this toward square leg with soft hands and takes a quick run.
Bowls this a fraction short and angling into the pads, Marnus Labuschagne clips this to mid-wicket.
Full and outside off once again, Marnus Labuschagne defends this to the off side.
Loopy delivery once again outside off, Steven Smith strokes this to the right of cover who gets a hand to it but parries it towards long off. They take a single.
Flights this one as well and serves this full outside off, Steven Smith taps this back to the bowler.
Mitchell Santner begins with full delivery flighted into the stumps, Steven Smith blocks this towards mid off.
We will see spin for the first time as Kane Williamson brings Mitchell Santner into the attack.

Goes full once again and outside off, Marnus Labuschagne looks to stroke this through the off side but gets an inside edge to the leg side. Another tight over from New Zealand as they have put shackles on the Australian batting.
On a good length and just outside the off pole, Marnus Labuschagne gets his front foot forward and blocks the ball back towards the bowler.
Strays onto the pads on a fuller length, Steven Smith clips this towards deep backward square leg and takes a single.
Lockie Ferguson serves this full and just outside the off stump, Steven Smith goes for the expansive drive and gets an inside edge towards square leg.
This is on a good length and in line with the stumps, Steven Smith looks to tuck this leg side but gets a leading edge back down the pitch towards the bowler.
Adjusts both his line and length as he bowls this full outside off, Steven Smith gets a stride forward and knocks the ball towards cover.
WIDE! Lockie Ferguson begins with a loose delivery bowled short and angling down leg. This is called wide by the umpire.
Lockie Ferguson replaces Tim Southee.
Continues to shape the ball in from just outside off on a good length. Another solid defensive shot from Marnus Labuschagne as he plays out a maiden over.
Make that five! Trent Boult serves this on a good length and outside off, Marnus Labuschagne gets across the stumps and defends this towards cover.
Bowls this slightly full and just outside off, Marnus Labuschagne is solid in defense as he blocks this to the left of the bowler. 4 dot balls in a row.
Much closer to the stumps this time on a fuller length, Marnus Labuschagne taps this towards short cover.
This is much wider outside off on a fuller length, Marnus Labuschagne is happy to let this go through to the keeper.
Trent Boult begins the over with a good length delivery well outside the off pole, Marnus Labuschagne leaves it alone and keeps the pose.
That is the end of Powerplay 1. 4 fielders can be placed outside the inner circle now till the 40th over.
Fullish one and on middle, Steven Smith stays there and tucks it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs. Australia are 19/2 after the end of Powerplay 1.
This again on a good length and around off, straightens after hitting the deck, Steven Smith lifts his hands and lets it through to the keeper.
Tim Southee serves another length ball, outside off, shaping away, Steven Smith lets it go to the keeper.
A single finally and the crowd cheers for that! This is on a hard length and around middle, Marnus Labuschagne works it through square leg for a run.
Good leave! This is on a good length, on off, nips back in, Marnus Labuschagne reads it well and leaves it alone as the ball goes just past the off stump.
On a length and around off, Marnus Labuschagne keeps it out.
Goes fuller and on middle, Steven Smith pushes it towards cover. Three maidens in a row for the Kiwis.
Length and outside off, Steven Smith leaves it alone.
Fuller one and on off, Steven Smith gets to the pitch of it to defend it out. Boult is giving nothing away here.
On a length and outside off, Steven Smith guides it towards backward point.
Full and on middle, Steven Smith tucks it towards short mid-wicket.
BEATEN! Boult comes over the wicket, and serves a good-length delivery, on off, angling away, Steven Smith looks to play at it but misses. Boult is unplayable at the moment.
Back-to-back maiden overs for the Kiwis! This is short of a length and on off, Marnus Labuschagne blocks it out again. This has been a brilliant start from the New Zealand bowlers.
Make that five dots on the trot as this full ball is driven towards mid on.
Goes a bit fuller and on middle, Marnus Labuschagne defends it off the front foot.
Three dots in a row! This is back of a length and outside off, Marnus Labuschagne plays it to covers.
Southee comes wide of the crease, angles a length ball onto the stumps, Marnus Labuschagne blocks it out.
Starts with a good-length delivery, outside off, shaping away, Marnus Labuschagne leaves it alone. Southee needs to make him play more.
A maiden over! This is on a length and on middle, Steven Smith keeps it out.
Another dot as this full delivery is blocked towards covers.
Full again and on the fifth stump line, Steven Smith knocks it towards point with his outer half. Four dots in a row now!
Goes fuller and on middle, nips back in, Steven Smith pushes it towards mid on.
BEAUTY! This is on a good length and around off, shaping away, Steven Smith looks to play at it but gets beaten on the outside egde.
Full and on off, Steven Smith blocks it out.
Another length delivery, outside off, Marnus Labuschagne offers no shot at it.
Back of a length and outside off, Marnus Labuschagne leaves it alone.
Marnus Labuschagne walk out to the middle to replace his skipper.

OUT! TIMBER! A peach of a delivery to get the wicket of Finch in his last ODI. Tim Southee bowled a couple of deliveries shaping away to Finch earlier, but this time serves a good-length delivery, on middle, shaping in, Aaron Finch looks to push it away but plays down the wrong line. The ball goes through the gap between bat and pad, and goes onto shatter the stumps. It is heartbreak for Finch and the fans as he goes for a cheap score. The crowd though cheers for him while he is walking back and he acknowledges it.
Fuller one but down the leg, Steven Smith looks to flick it but misses, and the ball goes off his pads towards short fine leg . A leg bye taken.
This is on a good length and on middle, Steven Smith moves across and knocks it towards square leg.
Full and on off, Aaron Finch drives it onto the ground, the bounce takes it over short cover and towards wide mid off. A single taken.
Ends the over with a good length delivery outside the off pole, Steven Smith taps this towards cover and that is a lovely over from Trent Boult. 4 runs and a wicket.
This is really full and just outside off, Steven Smith bumps the ball into the hands of short cover.
Trent Boult bowls this a bit fuller and in line with the stumps, Steven Smith blocks this back towards the bowler.
Steven Smith walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Trent Boult has struck early as he so often does! He bowls a tempter on a good length and just outside off, Josh Inglis feels for the ball as he looks to push it through the off side but gets a faint edge straight through to the keeper. Tom Latham makes no mistake behind the wicket and Trent Boult has drawn first blood.
Commentary.Howout: c Tom Latham b Trent Boult

Commentary.Commentary: This is on a good length and just outside off, Aaron Finch shimmies down the wicket and places this into the gap on the off side. Does not try to hit it too hard and gets three runs as the ball goes towards the deep cover-point boundary.
Trent Boult begins the over with a good length delivery outside off, Josh Inglis guides this to third man and takes a run.

Huge appeal but Aaron Finch survives! Tim Southee bowls this on a good length and gets the ball to nip back in sharply. Aaron Finch pushes at the ball and plays along the wrong line as the ball hits him high on the pads. There is a massive appeal from the bowler but the umpire remains unmoved. Kane Williamson has been convinced to take the review. The ball seems to be far from the bat and they do not check UltraEdge. Ball Tracking shows the ball is going over the leg stump and the skipper survives.
Goes fuller this time and outside off, Aaron Finch strokes this straight to short cover. Aaron Finch still finding it difficult to score runs.
Bowls this short and outside off, Aaron Finch slashes this straight to the extra cover fielder.
Bowls a slower delivery full and just outside off, Aaron Finch pushes at this and gets an inside edge onto the pads.
This is on a good length and closer to the stumps, Josh Inglis guides this towards third man for a single.

DROPPED AND FOUR! This has been slapped away! Brings the first boundary for Australia. Tim Southee bowls this short and outside off and Josh Inglis hits this aerially towards Glenn Phillips at point. The ball hits his palms and parries towards the deep point fence for four runs. Josh Inglis gets a life.
This is a touch fuller and straight once again, Josh Inglis gets another leading edge towards mid off but they steal a single this time.
Trent Boult serves this wide outside off on a good length, Josh Inglis goes for the drive but gets beaten on the outside edge.
This is on a good length and angling away a bit after pitching on middle, Josh Inglis looks to work this leg side but gets a leading edge back down the pitch.
Goes a touch fuller and in line with the stumps, Aaron Finch clips the ball to the left of short mid-wicket and takes a quick run to get off the mark.
This is on a good length and outside the off pole, Aaron Finch taps this to the off side.
Trent Boult bowls this on a good length and gets the ball to nip back into the batter, Aaron Finch defends this towards mid-wicket.
Goes back to bowling on a good length and outside off, Josh Inglis guides this to the second slip fielder.
Goes a fraction fuller and serves this outside off, Josh Inglis is watchful as he leaves this one alone.
Strays onto the pads on a good length, Josh Inglis clips this past square leg and they pick up a couple of runs.
Decides to bowl this on a good length and in line with the stumps, Josh Inglis blocks this towards short mid on.
Bowls this back of a length and outside off, Josh Inglis taps this down towards point.
Tim Southee starts off with a short delivery wide outside off, Josh Inglis slaps this towards point and a good stop by the fielder diving to his right.
Tim Southee to share the attack with Trent Boult.
Edged but falls short! Trent Boult serves this on a good length and outside off, Aaron Finch pushes at this and gets an outside edge just short of the slip fielder. Just one run from the first over.
Trent Boult serves this on a good length and just outside off, Aaron Finch taps this towards short cover.
This is a touch fuller and in line with the stumps, Aaron Finch clips this towards the square leg fielder.
Width on offer as this is bowled on a good length. Josh Inglis guides this to third man and takes a single to get off the mark.
Comes closer to the stumps and continues to bowl on a good length. Josh Inglis gets the inside half of his bat on the ball and defends it back to the bowler.
Trent Boult begins with a good length delivery just outside off, Josh Inglis blocks this towards mid off.

Earlier, the players had lined up in the middle and observed a minute of silence in the memory of Queen Elizabeth II. May her soul rest in peace. The prematch formalities are complete and we are all set for the game. The umpires have made their way out to the middle followed by the New Zealand players who applaud Aaron Finch as he makes his way out to the middle. The crowd joins the applause to honor a servant of Australian cricket and he wil be joined by Josh Inglis to open the innings. Trent Boult has been given the new ball and will start proceedings with the ball. Let's play...

As expected there are a few changes to both teams. Australia have brought back Cameron Green who has been in great bowling form recently and Josh Inglis has been given the opportunity in the absence of David Warner. He will be relishing this opportunity to bat with his skipper in his last game and will know that there is a spot up for grabs. New Zealand are going to give both Finn Allen and Glenn Phillips a game, which is probably for the best because the team has not been able to get their batting in order in the previous games. Matt Henry seems to be a late omission as he is rested due to some discomfort in his left side.

New Zealand (Playing XI) - Finn Allen (In place of Martin Guptill), Devon Conway, Kane Williamson (C), Tom Latham (WK), Daryl Mitchell, Glenn Phillips (In place of Michael Bracewell), James Neesham, Mitchell Santner, Lockie Ferguson (In place of Matt Henry), Tim Southee, Trent Boult.

Australia (Playing XI) - Aaron Finch (C), Josh Inglis (In place of David Warner), Steven Smith, Marnus Labuschagne, Alex Carey (WK), Cameron Green (In place of Marcus Stoinis), Glenn Maxwell, Sean Abbott, Mitchell Starc, Adam Zampa, Josh Hazlewood.

TOSS - Aaron Finch walks out for a toss in an ODI game for the last time and is joined by Kane Williamson. The coin is flipped into the air and lands in favor of New Zealand. They have elected to BOWL first.

New Zealand on the other hand have been not convincing at all with their batting. Their bowling has been good with Trent Boult and Matt Henry both firing. Their batters need to step up big time to get a win here. It will be interesting to see whether Finn Allen or Glenn Phillips get a game here. They had lost just one of their 10 games in 2022 beofre this series and they two losses here has dropped them from the top spot in the ICC rankings. They will need contributions from both units to end their 13-year-long wait to defeat Australia on their home soil. Can they do it? We will find out soon. Stay tuned for toss and other updates.
